import sys, os, json, hashlib, math, statistics, time, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('integrations/forty_five').resolve()))
from bridge import Worker

def status():
    return subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used,clocks.sm,power.draw','--format=csv,noheader,nounits'],text=True).strip()
def run(micro,repeats):
    out=Path(f'target/forty_five_bf16_headroom/compute-probe/micro{micro}')
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    archive=Path('target/forty_five_validation/final-driver/initial').resolve()
    batch_path=Path('target/forty_five_matmul_unroll/graph-tree-paired-micro64/batch.json')
    batch=json.loads(batch_path.read_text())
    paths=[Path('/tmp/tnsr-gemm-startup-final-worker'),Path('/tmp/tnsr-bf16-compute-worker')]
    settings=dict(microbatch=micro,scheduler_updates=1000,learning_rate=5e-5,value_learning_rate=2e-4,entropy_coef=.005,tree_reductions=True,cuda_graphs=True,tf32x3=True)
    report=dict(settings=settings,notes=['Arithmetic substitution only: BF16 shared operands, f32 accumulation and f32 global storage/output. Not mixed-precision training or numerical parity.','Each worker evolves from the same initial archive on repeated fixed batches; trajectories differ with precision.'],worker_sha256=[hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths],weights_sha256=hashlib.sha256((archive/'weights.f32').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),batch_sha256=hashlib.sha256(batch_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),gpu_before=status(),samples=[[],[]],warmups=[[],[]])
    workers=[]
    os.environ.update(TNSR_BF16_COMPUTE_PROBE='1',TNSR_PROFILE_PPO='1',TNSR_PROFILE_PPO_DUMP=str(out/'plan'))
    try:
        workers=[Worker(p,archive,'cuda') for p in paths]
        for it in range(5+repeats):
            for idx in ([0,1] if it%2==0 else [1,0]):
                began=time.perf_counter();result=workers[idx].request('train',batch=batch,settings=settings);elapsed=time.perf_counter()-began
                assert result['matmul_precision']==['tf32x3','bf16_compute_probe'][idx],result
                assert all(math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in result['metrics'].values()),result['metrics']
                assert result['cuda_graphs']['active_shapes']==1 and result['cuda_graphs']['fallbacks']==0,result['cuda_graphs']
                report['warmups' if it<5 else 'samples'][idx].append(dict(seconds=elapsed,**result))
            (out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
            if it%25==0:print(micro,it,[round(report['warmups' if it<5 else 'samples'][i][-1]['seconds']*1000,2) for i in range(2)],flush=True)
        a,b=report['samples'];report['summary']=dict(median_ms=[statistics.median(x['seconds'] for x in rows)*1000 for rows in (a,b)],wins=sum(y['seconds']<x['seconds'] for x,y in zip(a,b)),median_paired_ratio=statistics.median(x['seconds']/y['seconds'] for x,y in zip(a,b)))
        report['gpu_after']=status();(out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(micro,report['summary'],flush=True)
    finally:
        for w in workers:w.close()
for micro,repeats in [(64,200),(8,100)]:run(micro,repeats)
